oauth.consent.title: Connect an application
oauth.consent.heading: {client} is asking for access
oauth.consent.lead: Once you allow it, the application acts on your behalf in the chosen organization, only within the permissions you tick. You can disconnect it at any time in Settings.
oauth.consent.selfDeclared: The application chose this name itself and nobody verified it: anyone can register an application under any name. Allow only if you started connecting from it a moment ago and recognise the return address below. Allowing from a link someone else sent you gives that person access to the organization's data.
oauth.consent.redirect: After your decision you return to: {host}
oauth.consent.org.hint: The application sees data of this organization only.
oauth.consent.scopes.hint: Untick the permissions the application does not need.
oauth.consent.scope.unavailable: Not available to your role in this organization
oauth.consent.error: Could not load the access request
oauth.consent.error.noGrantable: Your role in this organization cannot grant any of the requested permissions. Choose another organization or ask the owner or an administrator.
oauth.consent.error.redirect: The return address of the application is not valid. Connect the application again.
oauth.consent.expired.title: The access request has expired
oauth.consent.expired.body: Go back to the application and start connecting again.
oauth.consent.notFound.title: Access request not found
oauth.consent.notFound.body: The link is not valid or a decision was already made. Go back to the application and start connecting again.
oauth.consent.noOrgs: You do not belong to any organization, so you cannot grant access. You can only deny.

onboarding.error.dpa: To continue, accept the data processing agreement.

settings.title: Settings
settings.nav.label: Settings sections
settings.retention.title: Data retention
settings.retention.label: Data retention period (days)
settings.retention.hint: Uploaded files are deleted after this period, counted from the upload day (a change applies to files uploaded later). Report files older than this period are deleted automatically; the report's SHA-256 hash stays and can still be used for verification.
settings.retention.error: Enter the number of days as a whole number from 1 to 3650.
settings.llm.title: Language model summary
settings.llm.label: Allow a language model to summarize the report
settings.llm.desc: Off by default. When on, only aggregated numbers are sent to the model, without order numbers or product names. The report will note that the summary was generated by a model.
settings.usage.title: Usage this month
settings.webhooks.title: Webhooks
settings.webhooks.lead: We notify the given address when a report finishes. Every call is signed (X-DaaS-Signature header, HMAC).
settings.webhooks.error.url: Enter an address starting with https://, for example https://your-company.com/hooks/daas.
settings.webhooks.caption: Configured webhooks
settings.webhooks.pingFailClass: Test failed ({class}). Check the address and the server response.
settings.webhooks.pingNoAnswer: Test failed (no response). Check the address and that the server is reachable.
settings.webhooks.pingFail: The test failed. Check the address and that the server is reachable.
settings.webhooks.delete.title: Delete webhook “{url}”?
settings.webhooks.delete.body: Notifications will stop being sent to this address. This cannot be undone.
settings.webhooks.delete.error: Could not delete the webhook. Please try again.
settings.webhooks.empty: No webhooks have been added yet.
settings.webhooks.secret.title: Save the signing secret
settings.webhooks.secret.body: This secret is used to verify call signatures. You can only see it now.
settings.connectedApps.title: Connected applications
settings.connectedApps.lead: AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude and others) connected to the organization through OAuth. Disconnecting takes effect at once.
settings.connectedApps.caption: Connected applications of the organization
settings.connectedApps.noAccess: The owner or an administrator of the organization manages connected applications.
settings.connectedApps.disconnect.title: Disconnect {app}?
settings.connectedApps.disconnect.body: The application loses access to the organization at once. Connecting it again needs a new consent.
settings.connectedApps.disconnect.error: Could not disconnect the application. Try again.
schedule.title: Schedule and notifications
schedule.lead: The Monday report without manual clicks: a reminder to export, an automatic run after the upload and an e-mail when the report is ready. Messages go to every member of the organization.
schedule.reminder.label: Send a weekly e-mail reminder to export
schedule.reminder.hint: The message only contains a link to the upload screen of the cockpit.
schedule.weekday.label: Day of the week
schedule.weekday.error: Choose a day of the week from the list.
schedule.hour.label: Time
schedule.timezone.label: Time zone
schedule.timezone.hint: IANA zone name, e.g. Europe/Warsaw. The reminder time follows this zone, also across clock changes.
schedule.timezone.error: Unknown time zone. Enter an IANA name, e.g. Europe/Warsaw.
schedule.skip.label: Skip the reminder if a file was uploaded in the last 6 days
schedule.autorun.label: Run the report automatically after an upload
schedule.autorun.hint: Processing starts right after the upload. When the plan limit is used up, the file is kept and you start the report by hand.
schedule.notify.label: Send an e-mail when the report is ready or has failed
schedule.notify.hint: The message only holds the pipeline, status, data period, SHA-256 digest and a link to the report in the cockpit. The report content stays in the cockpit.
schedule.readonly: The schedule is changed by the owner or an administrator of the organization.
schedule.webhook.title: Chat notification
schedule.webhook.lead: After every report we post a short message to your team channel: status, data period, SHA-256 digest and a link to the report in the cockpit. The report content stays in the cockpit. Works independently of the e-mail.
schedule.webhook.kind.label: Chat type
schedule.webhook.kind.error: Choose a chat type from the list.
schedule.webhook.url.label: Webhook address
schedule.webhook.url.hint: The address works like a password: once saved we only show its beginning and end. Leave the field empty to keep the saved address.
schedule.webhook.url.error: Paste the full address starting with https:// (up to 512 characters). Local network addresses are not allowed.
schedule.webhook.none: No address saved: chat messages are not sent.
schedule.webhook.removePending: The address will be removed when you save the schedule.
schedule.webhook.help.summary: Where do I find the address?
schedule.webhook.help.slack: In Slack, create an app with “Incoming Webhooks” turned on and add a webhook for the channel that should get the messages. Copy the address starting with hooks.slack.com and paste it above.
schedule.webhook.help.teams: In Microsoft Teams, open the Workflows app and create a flow from the “Post to a channel when a webhook request is received” template. Copy the address from the “When a Teams webhook request is received” step and paste it above.
schedule.webhook.help.generic: Any service that accepts a JSON POST (for example n8n or Make) gets a run.finished event with the data period, SHA-256 digest and a link to the report. The message is not signed, so protect the address like a password; signed events come from the webhooks in Settings.

keys.reveal.body: This is the only time you can see the full key. Copy it and store it somewhere safe, for example in a password manager. Later you will only see its prefix.
